meta.name: cortex-model
meta.description: Build an ML pipeline — from data to trained model to serving endpoint. Use when asked to "build ML model", "train a model", "prediction pipeline", "classification", or "regression".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从数据到模型再到服务接口，一整套机器学习流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建从数据到模型部署的机器学习流水线
copy.tagline_en: Build a full ML pipeline from data to trained model to serving endpoint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly build an ML pipeline from data to deployment

howto.what: 当要求构建ML模型时，Claude会从数据验证到特征工程、训练基线模型、评估、部署REST服务端点，并添加监控日志。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建ML模型”、“训练模型”、“预测管道”或提到“分类”、“回归”时触发。

say.text: 帮我构建一个分类模型，预测客户流失。
say.note: 启动ML管道，从数据到部署。

say.text: 训练一个回归模型，预测房价。
为我的数据建立预测管道并部署端点。

howto.what_en: When asked to build an ML model, Claude validates data, engineers features, trains a baseline, evaluates, deploys a REST serving endpoint, and adds monitoring logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build ML model", "train a model", "prediction pipeline", or mention "classification" or "regression".

say_en.text: Build a classification model to predict customer churn.
say_en.note: Starts the pipeline from data to deployment.

say_en.text: Train a regression model to predict house prices.
say_en.note: Begins training a baseline and evaluation.

say_en.text: Set up a prediction pipeline for my data and deploy an endpoint.
say_en.note: Runs the full flow and creates an API.
